name: Michael Femi Alley
title: Principal Architect
leadQuote: Founder and Principal Architect of The Building Practice Ltd with 20 years of expertise in sustainable architecture, fire safety design, and green building solutions.
bioParagraphs: Michael Oluwafemi Alley is the founder and Principal Architect of The Building Practice Ltd, bringing over 20 years of comprehensive experience in architecture, building construction, green building design, fire safety in buildings, project management, and interior design. His extensive career has provided him with exceptional exposure through collaboration with reputable architects, engineers, developers, and construction industry stakeholders on numerous notable projects.

Michael's professional journey includes quality international-standard architectural training from various prestigious establishments. Most notably, he spent over eight (8) years at Design Union Consulting LLC, one of Nigeria's renowned multi-disciplinary consulting firms, where he rose to the position of General Manager of Architecture. This experience equipped him with the expertise and vision to establish The Building Practice Ltd as a leading architectural firm.

As a prime consultant on many projects, Michael has developed exceptional project management capabilities. His commitment to professional excellence is reflected in his numerous certifications and memberships, positioning him as a leader in sustainable architecture, fire safety design, and internationally compliant building solutions.
philosophyQuote: "Architecture is more than creating structures; it's about designing safe, sustainable, and functional spaces that meet international standards while serving the unique needs of our communities. Every project at The Building Practice Ltd integrates fire safety principles, sustainable design methodologies, and adherence to International Building Codes (IBC) and International Fire Codes (IFC). We believe that exceptional architecture combines aesthetic excellence with rigorous safety standards, environmental responsibility, and cultural sensitivity to create buildings that stand the test of time."

name: Toluwalase Akinpelumi
title: Architectural Designer
leadQuote: A multidisciplinary architectural designer and creative whose work sits at the intersection of functionality, innovation, and contextual relevance — with a passion for emerging technologies and AI.
bioParagraphs: Toluwalase Akinpelumi is a multidisciplinary architectural designer and creative, with over four years of hands-on experience in the Design, Branding, Construction and Real Estate industry. His work sits at the intersection of functionality, innovation, and contextual relevance, with a strong focus on delivering spaces that are both aesthetically compelling and practically efficient.

Since graduating with a Master of Technology degree from FUTA, Toluwalase has contributed to a range of residential and commercial projects, translating concepts into buildable realities through detailed design development and coordination. His experience spans design conceptualization, visualization, site coordination, and working collaboratively with project teams to ensure alignment between vision and execution.

Toluwalase continues to expand his professional capacity through continuous learning, including an interest in emerging technologies, cloud-based systems, and artificial intelligence — positioning himself at the intersection of design and innovation.
philosophyQuote: Toluwalase believes that the best architecture emerges where functionality meets innovation within its context. His multidisciplinary approach — spanning design, branding, and construction — allows him to see projects holistically, ensuring every space is not only visually compelling but practically efficient. He is driven by the conviction that continuous learning and embracing new technologies are essential to pushing the boundaries of what architecture can achieve.

name: Uche Anyanwu
title: Senior Associate
leadQuote: Senior Associate at The Building Practice Ltd, a Creative Enthusiast, Design Harmonist, and passionate advocate for a greener sustainable built environment with over 9 years of post-graduate experience.
bioParagraphs: Uche Anyanwu is a Senior Associate at The Building Practice Ltd, bringing over 9 years of comprehensive experience in architecture and sustainable design. He has worked on major medium and large-scale projects across various sectors, demonstrating exceptional creativity and technical expertise.

Uche is known as a Creative Enthusiast and Design Harmonist who brings a unique blend of artistic vision and technical precision to every project. His passion for creating sustainable built environments is evident in his approach to design, where he consistently integrates green principles and innovative solutions.

With international experience gained through his work with multinational steel prefabrication company Zamil Steel Egypt, Uche has developed a global perspective on architecture and construction. His diverse background across different architectural firms has equipped him with versatile skills and a comprehensive understanding of the industry.
philosophyQuote: "Architecture is the intersection of art and science, where creative vision meets technical precision to create spaces that inspire, function, and sustain. As a Design Harmonist, I believe in creating architectural solutions that balance aesthetics with functionality, innovation with tradition, and human needs with environmental responsibility. Every design should tell a story while serving its purpose efficiently and sustainably."

name: Vanessa
title: Graduate Architect
leadQuote: Driven and detail-oriented designer with a deep passion for interior architecture, spatial experience, and human-centered design.
bioParagraphs: Vanessa is a driven and detail-oriented designer with a B.Sc. in Architecture and a deep passion for interior architecture and spatial experience.

Her growing experience on-site has strengthened her understanding of materials, construction methods, and practical problem-solving, enabling her to bridge the gap between concept and execution effectively.

Beyond architecture, Vanessa is passionate about human-centered design, particularly how interior spaces influence emotion, interaction, and productivity. She believes strongly in the transformative power of well-designed environments and constantly seeks innovative ways to create spaces that are both functional and beautiful.

Her creative interests also extend into fashion design, where she explores form, silhouette, and personal expression through clothing. This dual lens sharpens her sensitivity to proportion, detail, and flow.
philosophyQuote: Vanessa believes well-designed environments can transform emotion, interaction, and productivity while remaining functional, beautiful, and purposeful.
